question: When did Ernest Rutherford publish the results of the gold-foil experiment, which showed that scattering is caused by a rigid, dense core at the centre of the atom - the nucleus?
solution:
The correct option is **__1911__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Gold-foil experiment** is also known as the **Geiger-Marsden Experiment.**
 
• In this experiment, an **alpha particle** beam is scattered when it strikes a thin **gold foil.**
 
• The experiments were performed between 1908 and 1913 by** Hans Geiger** and **Ernest Marsden** under the direction of **Ernest Rutherford.**
 
• The result was published by them after the experiment was conducted by them in **1910**.
 
• After the series of these experiments, it was concluded that every atom has a nucleus where all of its positive charge and most of its mass are concentrated.​
